_about: Consumables (resistor) bin base - desk console: scale on the flat top, LCD in the sloped front, electronics on the floor plate. Clearance fits = part + 0.3 (owner); insert holes / self-tap pilots undersize on purpose. Built by build.ps1 with door_enclosure/Build.cs + env_enclosure/EnvParts.cs + BinParts.cs.

bin_body._status: Side profile: back 75 high, flat top 115 deep (the scale), then the front slopes down to 30 at 165 (42 degrees) - the LCD reads well standing at the bench (owner: 'the angle as the image').

scale._status: MEASURED (owner) acrylic discs D101.05, 2.05 thick, whole scale 21.89 high. Owner: double-sided tape, not screws -> 1 mm recess D101.35 (+0.3) centres the BOTTOM disc only; nothing else touches the top disc. Load-cell cable (4 wires + Dupont 10.2 x 2.5) through a 6 x 12.5 slot beside the recess.

lcd._status: MEASURED (owner) black frame 73.83 x 24.12 -> window 74.13 x 24.42 (+0.3); green PCB 79.89 x 35.86 = standard 1602 (80 x 36) -> holes 75 x 31 (owner: 'do the holes okay' = standard pattern), M2.5 self-tap into 2.2 pilots. Boss 5.6 = frame ~8.6 above the PCB (ESTIMATE) - 3 wall: frame flush with the outside.

usb_access._status: ESP32 flat on the floor, back right, USB-C end at the right wall (notch from the bottom edge).

dc_in._status: 12 V in through the back wall: M16 gland 16.0 + 0.3, beside the buck (own buck - owner).

floor._tabs: 2026-10-25: no locating tabs - tabs on top + feet below meant the plate could not lie flat on the bed. Print TOP face down (feet up). The 4 M3 screws locate it.

cup_ring._status: MEASURED (owner) glass cup OD 80.36 -> ring ID 80.66 (+0.3); taped on the top acrylic, part of the tare.
